meta.match_uses: uniform tolerance override; catalog half-width is not the match window

decomposition.top3_p_definition: pre-specified trio; equals 1/44^3 for three rank-1s
decomposition.top3_selection_definition: P(at least 3 of 6 independent ranks equal 1), i.e. sort-then-pick of an all-rank-1 top group

reference_path.note: Exploratory rank-sum × anchor rate. Not Sweatman's published 1.4M (rank-sum × 2/7).

multiverse.validity_filter: observed Sagittarius × summer solstice is a hit under the path's catalog, tolerance, and anchor model

parameters.visible_pool_definition: Ptolemy 48 minus Canis Major, Lepus, Eridanus, and Argo Navis (Sweatman & Gerogiorgis 2025); not every modern constellation visible at 37N
